data.title: 7.2-Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Off Indonesia's Maluku Province, No Tsunami Threat
data.content:
Jakarta, November 21, 2026, SPA -- A 7.2-magnitude earthquake struck off the coast of Indonesia's Maluku province on Saturday, about 43 kilometers northwest of Southwest Maluku Regency at a depth of 125 kilometers, the Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) said.
    Initial assessments show no immediate tsunami threat, the agency said, urging residents to stay alert for aftershocks. No casualties or damage have been reported so far.
    -- SPA
18:53 Local Time 15:53 GMT
